rules.sql: SELECT record_id, COUNT(*) FROM consumable.company_financials GROUP BY record_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
rules.rationale: record_id is a deterministic SHA-256 hash of the grain (cik, business_term_id, fiscal_year, fiscal_period). Duplicates indicate a collision resolution or dedup guard bug. EDA: 34.3% of source groups have 2+ concepts — collision resolution must produce exactly one row per group.

rules.description: Every row has valid business_term_id (exists in concept_mappings)
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consumable.company_financials cf WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM base.concept_mappings cm WHERE cm.business_term_id = cf.business_term_id)
rules.rationale: All 25 business terms (BT-022 through BT-048) must exist in the concept_mappings table. Orphan business_term_ids indicate a mapping bug. Source: consumable-company-financials-eda.md

rules.description: Every row has valid cik (exists in entity_mappings)
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consumable.company_financials cf WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM base.entity_mappings em WHERE em.cik = cf.cik)
rules.rationale: All 20 companies must exist in entity_mappings. Orphan CIKs indicate a join bug in the build pipeline. Source: consumable-company-financials-eda.md

rules.description: No null val (every row has a financial value)
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consumable.company_financials WHERE val IS NULL
rules.rationale: The consumable table exists to provide values for cross-company comparison. A null val is meaningless — indicates a build bug where a row was created without selecting a value from the source facts. Source: consumable-company-financials-eda.md

rules.description: Unit matches expected unit for business term category (USD for dollar amounts, USD/shares for per-share)
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consumable.company_financials WHERE (business_term_id IN ('BT-044', 'BT-045', 'BT-046') AND unit != 'USD/shares') OR (business_term_id NOT IN ('BT-044', 'BT-045', 'BT-046') AND unit != 'USD')
rules.rationale: Per-share metrics (EPS Basic BT-044, EPS Diluted BT-045, DPS BT-046) use USD/shares; all other business terms use USD. Unit filtering is applied during build — mismatches indicate the filter is broken. Source: spec Section 2.3, consumable-company-financials-eda.md

rules.description: companies_reporting is accurate (matches actual distinct company count per business_term_id and fiscal_period)
rules.sql: SELECT cf.business_term_id, cf.fiscal_period, cf.companies_reporting, COUNT(DISTINCT cf.cik) AS actual_count FROM consumable.company_financials cf GROUP BY cf.business_term_id, cf.fiscal_period, cf.companies_reporting HAVING cf.companies_reporting != COUNT(DISTINCT cf.cik)
rules.rationale: companies_reporting is a denormalized aggregate computed during build. It must match the actual count of distinct CIKs for each (business_term_id, fiscal_period) combination. Discrepancies indicate the aggregate computation is out of sync. EDA: coverage ranges from 9 to 20 companies per business term. Source: consumable-company-financials-eda.md

rules.description: All 25 financial business terms represented in the table
rules.rationale: The consumable table must contain data for all 25 business terms (BT-022 through BT-048). EDA confirms all 25 terms have at least 9 companies in the source data, so missing terms indicate a build or filter bug. Source: consumable-company-financials-eda.md coverage matrix

rules.description: All 20 companies represented in the table
rules.rationale: The consumable table must contain data for all 20 companies in entity_mappings. EDA confirms all 20 companies report at least the 12 universal business terms, so missing companies indicate a build or join bug. Source: consumable-company-financials-eda.md coverage matrix

rules.description: Net Income magnitude should not exceed Revenue magnitude for non-financial companies
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consumable.company_financials ni JOIN consumable.company_financials rev ON ni.cik = rev.cik AND ni.fiscal_year = rev.fiscal_year AND ni.fiscal_period = rev.fiscal_period WHERE ni.business_term_id = 'BT-023' AND rev.business_term_id = 'BT-022' AND ni.cik NOT IN (19617, 886982, 1067983, 1403161) AND ABS(ni.val) > ABS(rev.val)
rules.rationale: EDA: 12 cases where abs(Net Income) > abs(Revenue) for non-financial companies. Root causes: Tesla pre-revenue era (2010-2012, 10 cases), Netflix early-stage (2012 Q1, 2014 Q1), and Exxon FY2008 (likely a quarterly-vs-annual revenue mapping artifact where $123M revenue paired with $45.2B net income). These are legitimate data artifacts from early-stage companies with tiny revenue, not pipeline bugs. P2 allows monitoring without blocking.

rules.description: Common metrics (Revenue, Net Income, Total Assets) should have >= 2 companies reporting per period type
rules.sql: SELECT business_term_id, fiscal_period, MIN(companies_reporting) AS min_reporting FROM consumable.company_financials WHERE business_term_id IN ('BT-022', 'BT-023', 'BT-024') GROUP BY business_term_id, fiscal_period HAVING MIN(companies_reporting) < 2
rules.rationale: EDA: All three core metrics (Revenue, Net Income, Total Assets) have exactly 20 companies reporting across all four period types (FY, Q1, Q2, Q3). Minimum observed companies_reporting is 20. If only 1 company reports a universal metric, something is wrong with the population. Threshold of >= 2 is deliberately conservative.

rules.description: Row count matches base.conformed_facts (1:1 presentation layer)
rules.sql: SELECT ABS((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consumable.company_financials) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base.conformed_facts))
rules.rationale: EDA: Both tables have exactly 28,849 rows. consumable.company_financials is a 1:1 presentation layer over base.conformed_facts — no rows should be created or lost during the promote. Any mismatch indicates a build or dedup bug.

rules.description: No fiscal year collisions (same company + metric + period + period_end_date in two fiscal years)
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT cik, business_term_id, fiscal_period, period_end_date, COUNT(DISTINCT fiscal_year) AS fy_count FROM consumable.company_financials GROUP BY cik, business_term_id, fiscal_period, period_end_date HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT fiscal_year) > 1)
rules.rationale: EDA: 0 fiscal year collisions found. A collision would mean the same company reported the same metric for the same period_end_date under two different fiscal years — indicating a collision resolution bug where two different source facts both survived.
